description: Match the user's goal to a capability key using natural language. Use when the key is unknown; use hydracept_capabilities when you already have a key or need the catalog. Keyless. No charge. Read-only. Returns: CapabilityResolutionResponse with ranked keys and rationale. Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT when intent is empty; UNAUTHORIZED when bearer is invalid.

intent.description: Required string: user goal in natural language (passed verbatim to the resolver).
intent.title: Intent

requirements.description: Optional object matching CapabilityResolutionRequest.requirements (e.g. modality tags). Default {}. runnableNow requires an authenticated project workspace on the API.
requirements.title: Requirements

name: hydracept_resolve_capability
title: Resolve a capability
